original_prompt.global_prompt: Four five-second shots retain the courtyard continuity: the woman standing quietly, both figures spaced apart, a closer view of her slight facial changes, and the older man's small turn while holding his coat front.

shots.text: In a snow-dusted courtyard, the Woman in gray coat stands with her arms down, wearing a white knit beanie over straight shoulder-length dark hair and a muted peach high neckline beneath her buttoned gray winter coat. Frame her in a medium view against softly blurred, thick pollarded trees and muted stone buildings with a railing. In soft overcast light, she looks slightly toward screen left, then lowers her gaze a little, maintaining a restrained, serious expression throughout the five-second shot.

A wide five-second view of the same courtyard places the Older man in earflap hat on the left and the Woman in gray coat on the right, standing several meters apart with a thick pollarded tree trunk between them. The older man has wispy gray hair and facial hair, a black earflap hat, a long brown-and-tan checked scarf, a dark brown jacket, dark trousers and gray shoes. He keeps his hands in his pockets and makes a small head adjustment. The woman retains her white beanie, peach neckline and gray coat, with dark fitted trousers and black ankle boots, her arms lowered. Keep both in place on the patchy snow beside the paved walkway and pale stone facade with tall glazed doors and ornamental arched grilles.

The Woman in gray coat remains in the same wintry courtyard, her white beanie, straight dark hair and muted peach neckline clear against the soft background of knotted tree trunks, pale masonry and thin snow. In this closer waist-up view, she holds her gaze slightly to screen left. Her slightly parted lips close and her head tilts subtly before she settles into a quiet, serious expression. Sustain the restrained pose for five seconds.

Beside a large knotted tree in the same snow-dusted courtyard, the Older man in earflap hat holds one hand against the front of his dark jacket beneath his long checked scarf. His wispy gray hair spills from the black hat. Starting with his face lowered in screen-left profile, he turns his head and shoulders to a more frontal angle, then holds that position with slight mouth movement. Black iron railings and pale buildings remain behind him in the muted winter light. Let this small turn and held posture occupy five seconds.
